RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December  19, 2003/Agrahayana  28, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
WIN2/NSESSION\RSQLE 80
Floating of global tenders by Railways
*261. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Railways have ignored the
claims of the Ranchi-based Heavy
Engineering Corporation while awarding
works as reported in the media;
(b) if so, the facts and details thereof;
(c) whether Railways  have been floating
global tenders for many of the important
works and ignoring the indigenous
companies; and
(d) if so, the corrective steps Government
propose to take in this regard?
Ecological parks in Gujarat
*262. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up any
ecological parks in the country particularly
in Gujarat;
(b) if so, the details and main features
thereof;
(c) whether there is any proposal to set
up more  ecological parks in the country;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Report of CRS on fire in Frontier Mail
*263. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA:
 Will the Minister of RAILWAYS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the probe
conducted by the Commissioner of Railway
Safety into the devastating fire in the
Frontier Mail on 15th May, 2003 which
claimed 36 lives, has blamed the negligence
of train staff for the mishap;
(b) if so, what are the details of the probe;
and
(c) what action has been taken against
the concerned staff ?

81
WIN2/NSESSION\4021RSQLE 81
Newspapers supplied to passengers
*264. SHRI GAYA SINGH: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to refer
to the answer to Unstarred Question  2090
given in Rajya Sabha  on 3rd July, 1998 and
state the details with names of the
newspapers being supplied to the passengers
in each Shatabdi and Rajdhani Express
trains on all Indian Railways at present?
Wildlife trade
*265. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a Delhi-based
NGO, Wildlife Trust of India, conducted a
study into wildlife trade in 2002 in Uttaranchal
and U.P.; if so, what were its findings; and
(b) whether Government are thinking of
having dialogue with Chinese and Nepalese
Governments in this regard so that wildlife
conservation is effectively taken care of ?
Dereserved forest areas
*266. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) the policy of Government to allot
periodic Deeds to the occupants in the
dereserved forest areas of Assam;
(b) whether Government have decided
to issue periodical pattas  to the occupants
in dereserved land of a thousand bighas in
Rangali Forest Reserve and sixteen
thousand  bighas in Panidihing Forest
Reserve of Sivasagar district of Assam;
(c) if so, what is the time-frame; and
(d) whether Government have any policy
to convert forest villages into revenue
villages in near future?
Collaboration in scientific and
technological fields
*267. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the  Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an agreement
between India and Italy has been entered
into to pave the way for enhancement of
collaboration in scientific and technological
fields;
(b) whether Government are also
thinking of networking of scientific research
laboratories and academia from both India
and Italy; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Buffer zone of Silent Valley
National Park
*268. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
reports on the buffer zone of Silent Valley
National Park, relating to destruction of the
area by the ganja mafia and the "Kakkivana
forgery";
(b) if so, the action taken thereon;
(c) whether there is any failure on the
part of the authorities in conducting the
cases properly; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to protect the
buffer zone of Silent Valley National Park?

82
WIN2/NSESSION\4021RSQLE 82
Equity of IFFCO
†*269. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether IFFCO (Indian Farmers
Fertilizers Cooperative) is considering to
return Government equity; and
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the quantum of Government equity?
Implementation of famine code
*270. SHRI M.V. RAJASEKHARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have prevailed upon the States to follow the
accepted norms and guidelines for tackling
the drought situation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

Import of Palm Oil
1853. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether India is still dependent on
imported palm oil due to huge deficiency in
domesitc oil seeds production; and
(b) if so, the measures proposed to
reduce dependence on imported palm oil
and to bring import bill under check?
Less income from BT Cotton for
farmers
†1854. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH ‘LALAN’:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the income
of the farmers growing BT Cotton in
Andhra Pradesh had been five times less
during 2002 as compared to those who had
grown normal cotton;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether Government have collected
any information regarding production of
BT Cotton in other States of the country;
and
(d) if so, the names of the States where
BT Cotton was grown during 2002, 2003
and per hectare net profit earned by the
growers from it?
National Policy on Pesticides
1855. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are thinking of
formulating a National Policy on Pesticides
of the increasing dangers to human health
from food, drinking water etc.;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2/NSESSION\4022RS 404
(b) whether the  eminent agriculture
scientist Dr. M.S. Swaminathan has also
called for a National Policy on Pesticides;
and
(c)  if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
MIS proposals of States
1856. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the specific proposals for Market
Intervention Scheme (MIS) received from
various States during the last five years,
year-wise, State-wise and commodities for
which MIS was sought;
(b) the number of schemes approved
and quantum of funds released, State-wise
and year-wise; and
(c) the results achieved during the said
period, State-wise?
Export of organic farm produce
1857. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to export Rs. 300 crores worth
of organic farm produce within the next
three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what steps Government are taking
to save agricultural products from chemical
pollution impact?
Assistance to Uttaranchal for milk
production and livestock development
1858. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether some proposals of
economic-technical assistance for milk
production and livestock development have
been received from Uttaranchal;
(b) if so, the details of such proposals
received during the last two years;
(c) whether all these proposals have
been accepted;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons for the delay?
Assistance to Tripura through
Hariyali project
1859. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
have received a number of proposals on
different projects from the Tripura
Government for construction of cold
storages, development of fish-market an
aqua resources through 'Hariyali'
programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the status of these proposals?
Facility for assessing area under
crops
1860. DR. K. KASTURIRANGAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are in the
process of establishing an exclusive facility
for assessing the area under different crops
and the production thereof, using modern
technologies, before the harvest, every year;
and
(b) if so , the details thereof?

WIN2/NSESSION\4022RS 405
Improving milk production
1861. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Centre
has decided to allow the National Dairy
Development Board (NDDB) to import
10,000 tons of milk powder;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the status of milk production in the
country vis-a-vis the demands, State-wise;
and
(d) the steps being taken to improve
the production and consumption of milk in
the country?

Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased

difficulties in cultivating their lands on the
